pages.text: $(italic)"It is not something that can be described in language."$()$(br2)This record comes from an exchange between O5-1 and Site-CN-25 Director Cheng Jiuzhang. Asked what the Throne actually is, O5-1 answered: I have seen the Throne. I even touched it, briefly, with my fingertips. But it is not something that can be described in language.
pages.title: Fragment: Throne

pages.text: $(bold)Event:$() someone in the previous iteration stood before the Throne for the first time - and confirmed that it cannot be described.$(br2)$(bold)Collection:$() kept in the archive container at the base of the $(l)End Throne$(). Fixed storage, not subject to random selection. Reaching the site is enough.
